findings.title: Sync panics if the workbench was not mounted
findings.message: Mount returns nil without creating w.host when the receiver is invalid, and Sync can also be called before Mount. Sync only checks Owner and Workspace, so it will nil-dereference w.host.DeleteChildren() and panic when the layout signature changes.
findings.suggestion: Return an error from Sync when w.host is nil, for example `if w.host == nil { return fmt.Errorf("workbench: not mounted") }`.

findings.title: Test does not assert the ratio it claims to verify
findings.message: The test is named RestoresTabsAndRatio and calls Resize("split", .7), but it never checks the resulting split ratio. A regression in syncLayout's ratio handling would go unnoticed. The final Move step only checks that three records exist, not that the panels were placed correctly. The OnChange and error paths are not covered either.
findings.suggestion: Assert that w.splits["split"].Splits()[0] is within tolerance of 0.7. After Move, assert that the tab and active state in "left" are correct.
